about: E116: a failed run whose cause was external (an outage, a quota, a platform limit, no file of ours at fault) may be dispatched again with the same inputs and no new commit only when it is listed here by PR: {"run": <failed run id>, "reason": "<the external cause, with its evidence>"}. ops/dispatch_guard.py reads it (GUARD_RERUN_WITHOUT_FIX).
